candidate_identity.intended_github_release: Candidate source snapshot only. The all-zero exact_commit sentinel means unresolved, not a Git commit, tag, or GitHub Release claim.

release_integrity_posture.deferral_or_unavailability_reason: Candidate-only source record; platform state and exact release identity require later exact-candidate review.
release_integrity_posture.reevaluation_trigger: Before C4, verify the exact candidate commit, current repository release settings, workflow tree, and approved release assets.
release_assets: No candidate asset is approved. A later C4 review must identify any exact Release asset.
unverified_properties: Exact candidate commit, hosted CI, protected-main commit, C4 authorization, tag, matching GitHub Release, release assets, and installed-runtime identity are not established.

platforms: Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS verification remains required for the future exact candidate.
supported_scope.approved_scope_statement: Maintenance-only source correction for dependency wording, current/historical lifecycle wording, and installation-version semantics. It adds no capability and is not C4 authorization or a hosted Release claim.

residual_risks: The all-zero exact_commit field is an explicit unresolved sentinel required by the unchanged schema; it must never be treated as a Git object or release evidence.
The exact candidate diff, material review, source-authority review, local tests, hosted CI, C4 authorization, tag/Release, and local adoption remain incomplete.
Historical v0.8.0 pre-C4 records must remain labeled historical and cannot replace v0.8.1 evidence.
incident_and_repair_route: Stop release activity, preserve exact evidence, notify the accountable human, and prepare a new corrective candidate. Never rewrite a published tag or Release.
